class Bad:
    n: int

def check(x: int) -> int fail Bad:
    """Return x when it is even; otherwise fail Bad carrying x."""
    ex check(4) == 4
    ex check(3) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    if x % 2 == 1:
        fail Bad(n=x)
    return x

def all_even(xs: list[int]) -> list[int] fail Bad:
    """Check every element of xs in parallel. Return the checked values in order, or fail with the failure of the lowest-index bad element, regardless of which thread finishes first."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex all_even([2, 4]) == [2, 4]
    ex all_even([4, 1, 3]) == Err(Bad(n=1))
    return par [check(x)? for x in xs]
